title: Scenario Inventory Contract (v4)
description: Machine-validated output of the Planner Agent. Consumed by Tester Agent. v4 removes catalog-matching fields and adds dimension, steps, and structured risks.

storyUrl.description: Full URL to the JIRA story

estimatedScenarios.description: Estimated number of scenarios to be generated

acceptanceCriteria.description: Number of acceptance criteria in the story

businessDomain.description: Derived business domain for tag assignment (e.g., checkout, auth, booking)

environmentLimitations.description: Optional. Specific things that could not be inspected/reached (Planner Step 2/4). Each entry names the exact full URL/endpoint and reason (never a blanket 'domain not accessible'). Consumed downstream for URL/health reasoning.

statefulElements.description: Optional. UI elements with observable state transitions discovered during app inspection (app-inspection.md). Helps the Tester/Automation know both states.

prerequisites.description: Optional. Availability signals gathered from the story (output-formats.md). Flows to the Tester as preconditions.

title.description: Short descriptive title of the scenario

description.description: Detailed description of what this scenario tests

category.description: Scenario category assigned by Planner Step 6. Priority when multiple fit: error-handling > boundary > negative > positive. The Tester reads this to decide TC generation and high-risk expansion.

dimension.description: Testing dimension this scenario targets (UI, API, or NF for non-functional)

preconditions.description: Conditions that must be true before executing this scenario

action.description: The action to perform (e.g., click, fill, navigate)

target.description: The target element or endpoint for the action

value.description: The value to use with the action (empty string if not applicable)

expectedOutcome.description: Expected result after executing all steps

confidence.description: Confidence level in the scenario's completeness and accuracy

source.description: Origin of this scenario. An acceptance-criterion reference (e.g. 'AC-2'), a PKB reference, or a fusion of both (e.g. 'AC-2 + PKB:screens/wizard-test-location', or 'PKB:workflows/offline-booking-flow (in-scope gap)'). See planner references/pkb-fusion.md.

dataDependencies.description: Data this scenario needs from another story/feature so it stays executable (Item 10). Optional.

needs.description: What data is required (e.g., 'a registered user email', 'an order id')

fromStory.description: Originating story key if known (e.g., BREW-90), else empty

howToObtain.description: Concrete way to obtain it: endpoint to call, fixture to reuse, or producing TC/story

pkbRefs.description: Optional. Product Knowledge Base artifacts this scenario is grounded in (AC + PKB fusion, see planner references/pkb-fusion.md). Carries page/flow context across the contract so the Tester can resolve the referenced screen docs and build precise steps/preconditions. Omit entirely when the scenario has no PKB match. PKB file base names only — no path, no '.md'.

screens.description: PKB screen doc base name(s) this scenario touches, e.g. ['wizard-test-location', 'book-ielts-sessions'] (resolves to {pkbDir}/screens/{name}.md)

workflow.description: PKB workflow doc base name this scenario follows, e.g. 'offline-booking-flow' (resolves to {pkbDir}/workflows/{name}.md)

navigationPath.description: The documented page sequence this scenario traverses, e.g. '/wizard/test-location → /wizard/test-date/{loc} → /book-ielts'

featureArea.description: The specific feature/area this risk targets. Consumed by the Tester skill's risk-based expansion to know WHAT to add boundary/negative tests for.

severity.description: Impact severity if the risk materializes

score.description: Risk score = severityValue * likelihoodValue (Critical=4, High=3, Medium=2, Low=1 x High=3, Medium=2, Low=1)

evidence.description: MANDATORY. Why this score — shows the severity × likelihood math and the source signals (bug count, dependencies, complexity, inspection). Planner Step 7 requires this; the Tester reads it to target expansion. No score without evidence.

mitigation.description: Strategy to mitigate or reduce the risk
